premises.text: Commercial job sites face unpredictable water leaks, mold growth, and fire damage with no active fire monitoring on most sites
premises.evidence_span: there's currently no active fire monitoring solution for most job sites today

premises.text: Real-time end-to-end environmental monitoring warns and mitigates damage, informs logistics, and creates a lasting building condition record
premises.evidence_span: the first real-time, end-to-end environmental monitoring solution designed specifically for the job site

premises.text: Smart sensors deploy easily in dynamic sites via magnets, hanging straps, and wraps, then alert via dashboard and smartphone push
premises.evidence_span: We deploy smart sensor networks on job sites

premises.text: Pricing is per-square-foot installation plus monthly fee bundling hardware, firmware, software, and analytics
premises.evidence_span: We charge $0.03 per square foot one-time installation fee, and $0.02 per square foot per month

value.text: Buildings are built with less time, less money, and higher quality through preventable-damage monitoring
value.evidence_span: Less time, less money, and with a quality never before seen

causal_links.evidence_span: most of which were preventable or mitigatable if they had a monitoring solution
bundling hardware, firmware, software, and data analytics into one easy package

notes: Water/mold/fire listed as one job-site risk problem set (v1.5.1 §4.1.6), not three premises. Warning, logistics, and Carfax-like record treated as applications of one monitoring mechanism; mounting methods and push notifications folded as deployment/UI cascade. Price amount and HWaaS bundle kept as one commercial premise. Anti-template: risk, product, and pricing are separately revisable.
